messages.subject: dartR.base warning re: ggplot2
messages.body_plain:
Hi all, I recently see this warning message. I cant see that its been discussed before  but sorry if I have missed it.

Warning message: The `size` argument of `element_rect()` is deprecated as of ggplot2 3.4.0. ℹ Please use the `linewidth` argument instead. ℹ The deprecated feature was likely used in the dartR.base package.  Please report the issue at <https://groups.google.com/g/dartr?pli=1>. This warning is displayed once every 8 hours. Call `lifecycle::last_lifecycle_warnings()` to see where this warning was generated.

messages.subject: Re: [dartR] dartR.base warning re: ggplot2
messages.body_plain:
Hi Alan

We are working on it. Basically ggplot renamed a parameter. Instead of line width we are still using size.

The warning has no effect yet.

Cheers Bernd
---------
